name: Data Capture Gloves
summary: A tactile data-capture glove that synchronizes forces, fingertip position and three-axis rotation for robot-training datasets. The manufacturer specifies 500 Hz sampling, USB or Wi-Fi connectivity, and a 2.5-hour battery duration.
